data.job: Turn these app reviews into a ranked bug backlog

params.condition: Is this text written by a user about the app?
params.true_means: Any user feedback about the app: complaints, bug reports, praise, feature requests, questions
params.false_means: Spam, advertisements, promotions, or text unrelated to the app

nodes.why: Drop spam and ads so later steps only judge real feedback.

params.instructions: Which category best describes the text?

options.bug: Reports something broken, crashing, failing, slow, or not working as expected
options.feature_request: Asks for new functionality or an option the app does not have yet
options.praise: Positive feedback with no complaint and no request
options.billing: About charges, payments, refunds, or subscriptions

nodes.why: Sort the feedback into bugs, feature requests, praise and billing.

params.focus: the specific problem or request in the feedback

nodes.why: Find the themes among bugs and feature requests.
Merge bug reports that describe the same problem.

dimensions.name: severity
dimensions.instructions: How severe is the problem described in the text for the user?
levels: A feature is broken or unusable
The app crashes, loses data, or charges money wrongly

nodes.why: Rate how severe each bug is for the user.

params.criterion: urgency of fixing this issue for users

nodes.why: Order the bugs by urgency, one entry per duplicate group, to make the backlog.
Count items per type and theme and average the bug urgency for the report.

data.why: Drop spam and ads so later steps only judge real feedback.
Sort the feedback into bugs, feature requests, praise and billing.
Find the themes among bugs and feature requests.

value.name: Login and Sign-in Issues
value.description: Problems with logging in or signing in, such as errors, loops, or inability to authenticate; not account creation or sign-up.

value.name: Sign-up and Account Creation Problems
value.description: Difficulties with creating a new account or signing up, including being stuck in loops or unable to complete registration; not logging into an existing account.

value.name: Article Reading Limits
value.description: Complaints about restrictions on the number of articles that can be read, such as daily or monthly limits; not about content quality or recommendations.

value.name: Offline Reading and Saving
value.description: Requests for offline reading capabilities or saving stories for later access without internet; not about reading history or bookmarks.

value.name: App Performance and Stability
value.description: Issues with app crashing, lagging, freezing, or not working after updates; not about specific features like login or reading.

value.name: Content Recommendations and Feed
value.description: Problems with the recommendation algorithm or home feed showing irrelevant or repetitive articles; not about reading limits or content quality.

value.name: User Interface and Display Issues
value.description: Problems with the app's visual display, such as dark mode readability, full screen mode, or formatting; not about performance or functionality.

value.name: Feature Requests and Missing Functionality
value.description: Requests for new features or restoration of removed features, such as editing, embedding, or history; not about bugs or performance issues.

value.name: Article Content Not Loading
value.description: Users cannot read or access any articles, often seeing no content or being told to check their internet connection despite having connectivity; not login or sign-in failures.

value.name: Post Creation and Publishing Failures
value.description: Users are unable to write, create, or publish posts and stories, or their published stories never appear; not issues with reading existing articles.

value.name: VPN and Region Access Blocks
value.description: The app or its content does not work when using a VPN or in specific countries such as Egypt; not general internet connectivity problems.

notes: refinement: ran on 30 outliers; 3 new themes (Article Content Not Loading, Post Creation and Publishing Failures, VPN and Region Access Blocks)
